slug: 2026-07-07 CBN's local data order puts Nigeria's data centres to test

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that a Central Bank of Nigeria directive requires banks, fintechs and payment companies to move transactional data from overseas cloud servers to data centres inside Nigeria by 1 January 2027 (no issue date given; article published 2026-07-07).
TechCabal reports the localisation directive was issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria for the banks, fintechs and payment companies it covers (article published 2026-07-07).

systems.country_label: commercial data centres, 50-56 MW live, about 124 MW installed
systems.owner: OADC, Rack Centre, Kasi Cloud, Galaxy Backbone, Equinix
